articles.title: Felix Sandoval, 71, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Felix Sandoval for the many years of service to Kettle Hill.
body: Felix Sandoval died in July at home on Union Drive, at the age of 71. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Lower Mil1race Improvement Group in his or her name.

Born in Kcttle Hill in the years after the war, Felix Sandoval spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughtcr, two grandchildren and many friends from Kettle Hill.
